name: 女童卡通连帽两件套款
description: 粉彩卡通风儿童两件套套图：白底主图、双色分类、微距细节与服务信任收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot, variant and trust screens; soft sakura pink #FADCE3 for selling and detail screens; pale blue tint #EAF4FB for macro; warm cream #F3E9DC for lifestyle
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft warm studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: smooth matte studio boards, light wood floor for lifestyle scenes
styleLock.iconSystem: thin rounded-line icons, numbered circles and dashed-circle badges in one accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the garment set; folded flat lay for variant and trust screens; consistent scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cute kidswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of sakura pink #FADCE3, rose pink accent #F27E9B, cloud blue #8FCDF0 and charcoal text #3A3A3C on clean white grounds; warm bright studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; rounded friendly sans-serif; thin rounded-line icon style with numbered circles and dashed-circle badges; clean kidswear photography mixed with minimal infographic tiles; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the garment set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no third-party character graphics.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清整套版型，干净合规赢点击
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, garment set laid flat and centered, full set visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The two-piece garment set laid flat and centered, photographed straight-on at eye level, top and bottoms arranged neatly with the full set visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the garments. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. Clean commercial kidswear e-commerce quality. Negative: no hangers or props, no child model, no readable lettering or logos on the fabric, no watermark, no extra text, no cut-off edges, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 一秒传达卡通主题套装的核心卖点，承接主图
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, medium shot of the garment set on the left two-thirds, framed from collar to knee
shots.lighting: soft warm studio key from the front left, gentle contact shadow
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the top 15% band reserved for the headline
shots.textZone: top 15% headline band plus two short plus-mark labels beneath it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} on a soft sakura pink field #FADCE3. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Medium shot of the garment set at a slight 3/4 hero angle on the left two-thirds, framed from the collar to the knee, occupying 50-60% of the frame. Soft warm studio key from the front left with a gentle contact shadow. Generous negative space across the top 15% band holds the headline 「{selling_point_1}」 with two short plus-mark labels 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{selling_point_3}」 in charcoal #3A3A3C beneath it. Negative: no invented price, discount or efficacy claims, no dense body text, no recognizable child face, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no readable brand lettering, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 并排展示两个配色，让买家快速选定颜色
shots.lighting: bright even flat lighting, minimal shadow
shots.background: white #FFFFFF ground with pale pink #FBE3E8 cards
shots.props: two rounded swatch cards with two-tone color dots
shots.whitespace: narrow even margins between the two cards
shots.textZone: short label band at the bottom of each swatch card
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce colorway variant layout of {product}, shot as a top-down 90-degree overhead flat lay. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two rounded cards in pale pink #FBE3E8 sit side by side on a white #FFFFFF ground, each card showing the folded set with a two-tone color dot; each card carries a short label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in charcoal #3A3A3C. Bright even flat lighting with minimal shadow. The folded sets occupy 70-80% of the frame overall with narrow even margins as whitespace. Negative: no unreadable tiny text, no invented color names or fabric claims, no readable brand lettering, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 让家长代入日常穿搭场景，感受套装的百搭性
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level medium shot showing the outfit in context, collar to ankles
shots.lighting: soft warm window light from the left, 5500K, natural soft shadows
shots.background: warm cream wall #F3E9DC with light wood floor
shots.props: a small backpack and a cushion, never covering the outfit
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} worn by a generic child model shown only from the neck down beside a bright living-room window. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level medium shot showing the outfit in context from collar to ankles. Soft warm window light from the left at 5500K with natural soft shadows. Warm cream wall #F3E9DC and a light wood floor. Props: a small backpack and a cushion, never covering the outfit. The outfit occupies 40-50% of the frame with no extra whitespace. Negative: no recognizable child face or likeness, no hands covering the garment, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered background.

shots.intent: 微距放大印花与缝线，证明做工与面料质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the right revealing fabric texture and stitch density
shots.whitespace: minimal, the macro detail itself is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the printed chest panel and its stitched edge. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Skimming side light from the right revealing the fabric texture and stitch density. Pale blue backdrop #EAF4FB. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace, the detail itself is the subject. Negative: no readable lettering or character artwork on the fabric, no blurry subject, no invented material claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 编号宫格讲清连帽、袖口、口袋与下摆结构点
shots.camera: each tile a tight zoom close-up photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down
shots.lighting: bright even lighting with soft shadows
shots.background: white #FFFFFF tiles on a white ground
shots.props: numbered circles 1 to 4 and short label tags
shots.whitespace: generous gutters between the four tiles as whitespace
shots.textZone: short label beside each numbered circle in the four tiles
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic of {product} built as four rounded detail tiles in a 2x2 grid on white #FFFFFF. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Each tile holds a tight zoom close-up of one construction point photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down: hood, cuff, pocket and hem, numbered with circles 1 to 4 and short labels 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 「{callout_5}」 「{callout_6}」 in charcoal #3A3A3C. Bright even lighting with soft shadows. The garment details occupy 50-60% of the frame with generous gutters between tiles as whitespace. Negative: no dense body text, no invented feature or performance claims, no readable brand lettering, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 翻开内里展示缝制工艺，消除做工与保暖疑虑
shots.camera: tight zoom on the opened seam, clean 90-degree side profile with the garment edge toward the camera
shots.lighting: soft directional light from the left with a skimming light along the seam
shots.whitespace: clean band on the right 25% reserved for copy
shots.textZone: right 25% vertical band beside the opened seam
shots.promptTemplate: Tight zoom detail photograph of {product} opened to show the inner lining and seam work. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile with the garment edge toward the camera, lining texture and stitching sharp. Soft sakura pink background #FADCE3 with soft directional light from the left and a skimming light passing along the seam to reveal stitch density. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame; a clean band on the right 25% is reserved as whitespace for the label 「{callout_7}」. Negative: no readable lettering on labels, no blurry subject, no invented fabric or thickness claims, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以空白服务徽章环收口降风险，背书留给真实内容
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, medium close framing on the folded set centered
shots.lighting: even bright studio lighting with soft contact shadows
shots.props: four dashed-circle service badge outlines around the folded set
shots.whitespace: even margins around the badge ring as whitespace
shots.textZone: short label inside each of the four dashed-circle badges
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level medium close framing on the folded set centered on white #FFFFFF, ringed by four dashed-circle service badges left as clean empty outline placeholders with short labels 「{callout_8}」 「{callout_9}」 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 in charcoal #3A3A3C with a rose pink accent #F27E9B. Even bright studio lighting with soft contact shadows. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame with even margins around the badge ring as whitespace. Negative: do not invent certifications, awards, ratings, test data or policy numbers, keep every badge interior empty, no recognizable child face, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no readable brand lettering, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 8 屏参考：P1 标题区（卡通主题休闲套装、荷叶袖与亮片装饰卖点、价格与市场价角标）与商品信息表（颜色两组、面料全棉、里料不倒绒、厚薄弹力柔软版型四条指数条）；P2 双色分类卡（灰+黄、蓝+粉两枚双色圆点）、WHY 三圆卖点位与五枚六边形图标（棉花/吸汗/透气/不起球/无静电）及吸汗透气横幅；P3 三张卖点卡（吸汗透气、柔软不起球、舒适穿着）与模特展示区标题；P4-P5 模特与场景图占位（源照片缺失）与细节展示标题；P6 编号细节 1-4（印花工艺、缩口袖口、立体耳朵装饰、防风连帽）与精工缝制、不倒绒内里横幅；P7 下摆松紧设计与口袋设计；P8 后背装饰设计与服务四圆环（天然、退换、工艺、服务）。品类判定：品名即卡通休闲套装，硬证据为防风连帽、口袋设计、下摆设计、后背装饰与「出游居家两不误」的外穿表述，属外穿休闲套装而非贴身内衣睡衣，故判母婴/童装而非儿童内衣。源页自相矛盾处（两片套装 vs 三件套设计、小飞袖雪纺袖 vs 缩口袖口）均未作为事实写入。已剥离：第三方卡通形象头图与熊猫图形、原品牌店铺字样、价格与市场价、面料克重数值、指数条读数、原文案原句与模特信息（模版统一改用颈部以下裁切的 generic child model）；数值与资质类内容一律改为 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 或空白徽章占位。
